name: Normalising Japanese Address Text
description: The text a Japanese address is reduced to before parsing: one width of digit, one kind of dash and space, and block numbers as digits, with the kanji numerals and long-vowel marks that belong to names left alone. Also which texts are recognised as Japanese addresses.

normalizeText.name: fold widths, tidy spaces and read kanji numerals
normalizeText.input: 〒１００－０００５　東京都千代田区丸の内一丁目二番三号
normalizeText.expected: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内1丁目2番3号

normalizeText.name: write a long-vowel mark between digits as a dash
keep the long-vowel mark inside a name
write a full-width F as F

kanjiNumerals.name: read tens and hundreds
kanjiNumerals.input: 二十三丁目四百八十八番地

kanjiNumerals.name: read numerals written digit by digit
keep the numeral in 北一条西 while reading the chome
keep the numeral in 三番町
keep the numeral in 麻布十番 before a chome
keep the numeral in 一ノ瀬
keep the numeral in 三軒茶屋
read a ban at the end after a chome

looksJapanese.name: recognise a prefecture beside a postal code
recognise a prefecture beside a designator
not take a US street named Japan
not take a US street named Tokyo
not take a Canadian street named Osaka
not take a ZIP+4 for a Japanese postal code
